title: Frozen capacity contract lacks composable same-CAS inventory gate

conditions.description: W21 frozen e3430a0 ProjectCapacityAdmission.reserve internally invokes LedgerStore.transact and its snapshot planner/read/change are private; no caller hook exposes that same snapshot or composes inventory mutations with reservation. A separate inventory read/transaction is TOCTOU and cannot establish required same-CAS boundary. Please coordinate a reviewed W21 composable snapshot/planner interface or explicitly resolve the boundary and lease; retain HOLD. W16 proceeds with independently safe standalone preparation.
conditions.evidence: Capacity handoff task spec v2 blob 2560c11eb5544aab8e2541c668974708bac0e55a assigns W21 bounded composition and race tests; challenge 9933f6e34abd449b937f4d8903727184 requests explicit adoption and source/review evidence. W16 inventory and live authority stay on HOLD until evidence exists.
conditions.reason: Reviewed composable same-CAS interface does not yet exist; Worker 21 must implement and submit it for independent review.
